preconditions.name: ARM_OFF_OFF::rv_live
preconditions.description: rv_final differs from precision_init by more than the floor (the Q-042/530c substrate-liveness contract). Worst cell reported.
preconditions.control: every seed of this arm; a dead rv makes the DV meaningless

preconditions.name: ARM_OFF_OFF::f1_recalib_engaged
preconditions.description: mean per-cycle |rv_after - rv_before| from the F1 WRITEBACK recalibration exceeds the floor, i.e. REM was entered and the MECH-204 lever moved rv. Phase 7's broadcast read is a no-op until a REM entry populates serotonin._persistent_zero_point.
preconditions.control: F1 recalibration is ON in every arm of this design

preconditions.name: ARM_BCAST_ONLY::rv_live
preconditions.description: rv_final differs from precision_init by more than the floor (the Q-042/530c substrate-liveness contract). Worst cell reported.

preconditions.name: ARM_BCAST_ONLY::f1_recalib_engaged

preconditions.control: F1 recalibration is ON in every arm of this design

preconditions.name: ARM_BCAST_ONLY::zero_point_populated
preconditions.description: fraction of this arm's cells whose serotonin._persistent_zero_point is populated at eval start. The broadcast returns its no-target sentinel (0.0) and does nothing when it is None.
preconditions.control: a REM entry must have occurred during training

preconditions.name: ARM_BCAST_ONLY::broadcast_moves_rv
preconditions.description: mean over seeds of |rv_final(this arm) - rv_final(matched broadcast-OFF arm)|. SAME STATISTIC the DV routes on (rv level), measured against a matched positive control differing only in the broadcast flag -- not a magnitude proxy (the V3-EXQ-643 defect).
preconditions.control: matched broadcast-OFF arm at the same inflation level, same seeds

preconditions.name: ARM_INFL_LO::rv_live
preconditions.description: rv_final differs from precision_init by more than the floor (the Q-042/530c substrate-liveness contract). Worst cell reported.

preconditions.name: ARM_INFL_LO::inflation_lowers_rv
preconditions.description: mean over seeds of (rv_final(matched inflation-OFF arm) - rv_final(this arm)). SIGNED: SD-076 must push rv DOWN (below the symmetric-EMA level) or it is not an inflation source. Same statistic the DV routes on.
preconditions.control: matched inflation-OFF arm at the same broadcast level, same seeds

preconditions.name: ARM_INFL_LO::dose_levels_separated
preconditions.description: |rv_final(this arm) - rv_final(sibling arm at the OTHER asymmetry, same broadcast level)|. THE 794 GATE: two nominally different doses producing the same rv is a SATURATION signature, not a null -- 794 measured EXACTLY 0.010000 on all four inflation arms and a bit-identical overconfidence_score at both doses. Same statistic the DV routes on, against a control differing ONLY in the dose.
preconditions.control: sibling inflation arm at the other asymmetry level, same broadcast level, same seeds -- differs only in the dose
